name: POS Cheque Info & Tracking For Enterprise
description: This module enhances Odoo Point of Sale by enabling businesses to securely collect and manage cheque details during POS transactions. When a customer makes a payment using a cheque, the cashier can enter key information such as bank name, account holder, account number, and cheque number directly from the POS payment screen. The recorded cheque details are automatically linked to the corresponding POS order and fully accessible from the backend for verification, reconciliation, and accounting accuracy.
summary: This module enhances the Odoo Point of Sale system by providing a secure and efficient way to collect cheque information during POS transactions. When a customer chooses to pay by cheque, the cashier is prompted to enter essential details such as the bank name, account holder name, cheque number, and account number directly within the POS interface. All captured cheque information is automatically linked to the POS order and stored in the backend, ensuring accurate traceability for accounting teams. This improves payment verification, simplifies bank reconciliation, and reduces manual paperwork or errors associated with cheque-based sales. Managing cheque payments in retail can often become messy and unorganized, especially when cashiers only record transactions without capturing critical cheque information. The Cheque Information Collection for POS Payments module solves this problem by enhancing Odoo POS system with seamless cheque data entry and backend visibility. It ensures that every cheque payment recorded in the POS is linked with accurate banking details such as cheque number, account holder name, bank name, and account number, making the entire process fully traceable and audit-friendly. This module introduces an intuitive pop-up form in the POS checkout interface that appears whenever a cheque payment is selected. Cashiers must enter all necessary cheque information before completing the sale, preventing missing or incorrect details. The collected information automatically flows to the POS Order backend, where accountants and managers can review it for bank clearance, reconciliation, or transaction verification. name: Custom Discounts for Point of Sale For Enterprise
description: Easily apply and manage custom discounts directly in your Odoo POS. This module empowers cashiers and managers to offer flexible price reductions, track discount reasons, and enhance customer satisfaction.
summary: The POS Custom Discount app for Odoo is a powerful and user-friendly extension designed to give businesses more flexibility and control over discount management within their Point of Sale operations. Standard POS modules typically provide fixed promotional discounts, but they often lack the ability to create customized offers that meet specific business needs. This app bridges that gap by introducing a Custom Discount feature, allowing POS users to create, apply, and track both predefined and custom discounts directly from the POS interface. With this app, administrators can enable the Custom Discount option from the Odoo backend under the POS settings. Once activated, the POS interface will display a dedicated “Custom Discount” button, alongside any existing discount schemes like seasonal promotions (e.g., “Christmas Offer”) or store milestones (e.g., “Shop 6-Year Completion”). This empowers cashiers or sales staff to either apply predefined discounts to selected order lines or the entire order, or create new custom discounts instantly during checkout. The process is straightforward: after selecting products in the POS cart, the cashier can open the discount dialog to choose from available offers or click on the Custom Discount button to create a new one. The system prompts the user to enter a discount percentage and a reason, ensuring that every custom discount is not only applied correctly but also documented for transparency. Discounts can be applied to individual items (Selected Line) or the entire order (All Line). This ensures maximum flexibility, whether the business wants to promote specific products or reward loyal customers with special order-wide deals.
